requirements.description: Microsoft FY2025 10-K: original definition of the Microsoft Cloud metric (its component revenue streams) and the FY2025 disclosed Microsoft Cloud revenue amount and growth rate vs FY2024, with units and period context.

Microsoft FY2025 10-K: Intelligent Cloud segment definition (full enumeration of principal products and services, heading and qualifiers) and FY2025 segment revenue and operating income with FY2024 comparatives and growth, in millions; plus MD&A Intelligent Cloud segment results discussion.

Microsoft FY2025 10-K: definition/composition of Azure and other cloud services and its affiliation within Intelligent Cloud server products and cloud services; FY2025 disclosed growth rate (34%); and the revenue disaggregation by product/service table and MD&A segment discussion to show whether an Azure dollar amount is disclosed (parent server products and cloud services amount vs growth rate), without estimating undisclosed Azure revenue.
